info.title: TEZAPI
info.description:
API provides capability to integrate TEZAPI services with client software.

Authorization is required to work with the gate. Using tour search in XML or JSON format you can find a suitable offer. Services for working with orders allow you to prepare your order in format necessary for booking, perform its initial calculation including the calculation of additional services and allow you to make a booking. Later, you can at any time get information on your booked orders. Data required for working with orders via API is stored in reference tables. Also you can get current price offers and track changes to them via the API. 

Working under the same login in the API Gate and in the Agency's Workplace is not recommended; only three sessions are available for one login at the same time.

The lifetime of an inactive session is 30 minutes; after this period, re-authorization is required.

All data in the API are transmitted in UTF-8 encoding.

    # 🔐 API ACCESS REQUIREMENTS

**⚠️ IMPORTANT: ACCESS TO THIS API IS RESTRICTED**

| Service | Access Level | Requirements |
|---------|--------------|-------------|
| Tour Search | Public | No restrictions |
| All Other Endpoints | **Limited** | **Approval required** |

## 🚫 Access Policy
**Full API access is granted exclusively upon formal request through your agency's curator.**

- ❌ Technical support cannot enable API access
- ❌ No automatic registration available  
- ❌ IP-based restrictions apply
- ✅ Contact your agency manager/curator for access requests

## 📞 Contact for Access
- Reach out to your TEZ TOUR business representative
- Discuss integration needs and obtain approval
- Technical team will contact you after business approval

---

get.description:
Retrieve comprehensive information about a specific order including:

- **Order details** (type, status, pricing, dates)
- **Tourist information** (personal data, passport details)  
- **Services** (accommodation, transfers, flights, insurance, extras)
- **Document links** (e-tickets, insurance, vouchers)
- **Service-tourist mappings**

**Document Types:**
- `eTicketURL` - Electronic tickets (available when ready)
- `insuranceUrl` - Insurance documents
- `aviaNoteUrl` - Aviation notes (typically available after departure)
- `voucherUrl` - Vouchers
- `extraURL` - Additional documents for regular flights

**Note:** Add 'aid' parameter when accessing document URLs.

get.description:
Generates complete order XML template based on price offer and selected services.

**Purpose:**
- Creates structured order XML with all required sections
- Pre-populates service information from price offer
- Provides template for tourist data and service-tourist mappings

**Generated Structure:**
- Order type and country information
- Price offer details (SPO)
- Tourist templates (with IDs for mapping)
- Service blocks (Residence, Transfer, Ticket)
- Service-tourist mapping templates

**Next Steps:**
1. Fill tourist personal data in generated XML
2. Pass to `/calculate` for price verification
3. Pass to `/book` to create booking

post.description:
Perform preliminary calculation of order price before booking.

Calculates total order price including base tariff, insurance, extra services, 
and visas. Returns detailed price breakdown with agency commission.

**Calculation Includes:**
- Base price from price offer (SPO)
- Insurance costs
- Extra services and supplements  
- Visa fees
- Agency commission and discounts

**Note:** Calculation uses current tariff availability and prices may change until booking.

get.description:
Search for regular (scheduled) flights for tour packages that require additional flight matching.

**Use Cases:**
- Flights marked with `<externalFlights><value>true</value></externalFlights>` in tour search
- Regular flights not included in charter packages
- Long-haul flights requiring specific routing

**Integration Notes:**
- Use parameters from tour search booking URLs or specify manually
- Supports multi-segment flights (connections)
- Returns detailed fare information for different passenger types

get.description: Get flexible commission rules and rates

Get list of available countries.

**Access:** IP whitelisting required (no authentication)

Returns comprehensive list of all countries supported by the system
with their identifiers and English names.

**Reference Structure:**
- Standard reference format with list metadata
- Each country includes ID and name
- Supports filtering and pagination on the server side

**Response Fields:**
- `listName` - Name of the reference list
- `itemCount` - Total number of items in the list  
- `item` - List of country items with:
  - `type` - Item type (Country)
  - `row` - Sequential row number
  - `id` - Country identifier
  - `name` - Country name in English
  
**Usage:** Specify `countryId` parameter in tour search requests
- TURKEY: `countryId=1104`
- THAILAND: `countryId=12695`

```http
GET /tariffsearch/getResult?countryId=12695&...
```

get.description:
Get list of available cities.

**Access:** IP whitelisting required (no authentication)

Returns comprehensive list of all cities supported by the system
with their identifiers, names in English and Russian, geographic associations,
and timezone information.

**Reference Structure:**
- Standard reference format with list metadata
- Each city includes ID, names, country/region associations, IATA codes, and timezone data
- Supports filtering and pagination on the server side

**Response Fields:**
- `listName` - Name of the reference list
- `itemCount` - Total number of items in the list  
- `item` - List of city items with:
  - `type` - Item type (City)
  - `row` - Sequential row number
  - `id` - City identifier
  - `name` - City name in English
  - `prop` - Country association with name="Country"
  - `region` - Region identifier the city belongs to
  - `name_rus` - City name in Russian (optional)
  - `iata_code` - IATA airport code associated with the city (optional)
  - `tzname` - Timezone name
  - `gmt_offset` - GMT offset in minutes
  
**Usage:** Specify `cityId` parameter in tour search requests
- MOSCOW: `cityId=345`
- ISTANBUL: `cityId=6623`

```http
GET /tariffsearch/getResult?cityId=345&...
```

itemCount.description: Total number of items in the list

region.description: Region identifier the city belongs to

iata_code.description: IATA airport code associated with the city (optional)

get.description:
Retrieve system limitations and constraints for tour search operations.

Returns current search restrictions including date ranges, night limits,
and maximum price ranges by currency to help build valid search requests.

**Use Cases:**
- Validate search parameters before making requests
- Display appropriate date pickers and price sliders in UI
- Prevent search errors due to parameter violations

**Restriction Types:**
- **Date Range Limits**: Maximum allowed range between check-in dates
- **Night Stay Limits**: Maximum allowed range for night counts  
- **Price Range Limits**: Maximum price ranges by currency
- **Booking Window**: Maximum days in advance for booking
